limits.en: 300 MB of file storage for PDFs, images, snapshots and attachments; library metadata, notes, tags and collections sync free and unlimited regardless of file storage tier.

keyLimits.en: $20/year (≈$1.67/month), billed annually only. 2 GB of file storage.
$60/year (≈$5/month), billed annually only. 6 GB of file storage.
$120/year (≈$10/month), billed annually only. Unlimited file storage.

cautions.en: All paid storage tiers are billed annually (no separate monthly billing option confirmed); the monthly figures shown are annual price divided by 12.
Storage plans cover only attached files (PDFs, images, snapshots); reference metadata itself always syncs free and without limit.

capabilities.en: Free, open-source reference manager for collecting, organizing, citing and sharing bibliographic research.
Syncs PDFs, images, web snapshots and other attached files across devices via Zotero's own storage or a linked cloud service.
Group libraries allow shared research collections, with storage drawn from the group owner's paid quota if applicable.
Browser connector for one-click saving of citations and full-text attachments from library databases and websites.

limitations.en: Free tier's 300 MB file storage fills up quickly for researchers attaching many full-text PDFs.
Paid storage plans are billed annually only, with no monthly billing option, requiring upfront commitment.
